The empirical findings are backed by objective execution statistics, multi-judge automated reviews, and human expert validation, with candid treatment of unresolved flaws.

evidence.excerpt:
proposeMulti-Hypothesis Failure Attribution (MHFA), a recovery framework that operationalizes the method
of multiple working hypotheses (Chamberlin, 1965; Platt, 1964) for autonomous research agents. As illustrated
in Figure 1(b), MHFA structures recovery as a three-stage process of divergent generation, convergent scoring,
and deterministic routing. A divergent generator first synthesizes distinct, evidence-grounded explanations of
the failure trajectory. An independent critic then scores the severity and evidential support of each explanation.
Finally, rather than letting the model hallucinate a fix, a deterministic routing rule maps the verified structural
cause to a hierarchy-aware intervention, such as method refinement, protocol redesign, or hypothesis pivoting.
Low-level zero-metric execution failures are handled by a separate explicit repair path before structural
attribution.

Failure Severity Ranking.Scoring hypotheses with the same LLM instance that generated them invites
self-endorsement. Therefore, the second stage uses an independent critic with a "skeptical" persona. The
critic audits the logical soundness ofdi against the cited evidenceei, rectifies the categoryci if needed, and

fatal directional failures (Section B). The top-scoring hypothesish∗ = arg maxisi becomes the intervention
target, carrying its rectified categoryc∗ and verified scores∗.

2026), an external open-ended autonomous research benchmark. The subset spans five domains: six topics
in machine learning, two in statistics, two in quantum computing, one in biology, and one in high-energy
physics; the selection protocol and full topic list are given in Section A. For a controlled comparison, all
systems, including AI-Scientist-v2, are rerun on the identical topic set using the same backbone model and
model snapshot, API configuration, per-topic LLM and experiment-execution budget caps, wall-clock limit,
hardware resources, and software environment. We define a run asmetrics-bearingif its experiment stage
emits at least one task-relevant measured metric, rather than only run counts, logs, or timing

way (Table 5).
With a single hypothesis, a misattributed cause is never corrected:
the run commits to a surface-level fix and ships a thinner, degraded
paper. Without the critic, self-endorsement bias lets the generator
rank a secondary cause as most critical, so the router intervenes at the wrong level. Without MHFA, the
system has no structured diagnosis at all and either writes on a broken experiment or blindly code-repairs,
frequently degrading or failing outright. Only the full system routes the verified critical cause to the appropriate
intervention and recovers clean, metric-bearing artifacts. This indicates that the multi-hypothesis structure,
not the repair path alone, is what drives reliable recovery.

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline recovery gain is corroborated by objective execution measurement (11/12 vs 5/12 metrics-bearing topics) and by blind human expert evaluation showing a statistically significant advantage (p = 0.031) [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0048, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0066].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are established by objective execution success (metrics-bearing runs), blind LLM artifact judges, and blind human expert ratings from three ML PhD reviewers [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0043, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0048, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0060, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0066].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The recovery loop is shaped by trajectory features (decay, slope) and an independent LLM critic that assigns severity scores, which feed a deterministic routing rule to select repairs [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0028, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0029, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0030].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims are well-aligned and carefully calibrated: the authors explicitly emphasize that autonomous paper generation remains far from venue-ready quality, pointing out persistent method-provenance gaps and prose-table coordination errors rather than claiming full scientific automation [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0046, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0055, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0068].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation spans 12 topics across five distinct scientific domains, comparing SAGE against both the host pipeline baseline (AutoResearchClaw) and AI-Scientist-v2 under fixed compute and model configurations [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0039, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0040, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0041]. Evaluation metrics combine objective execution recovery rates (increasing metrics-bearing runs from 42% to 92%), blind LLM-based rubric evaluations (AR-Eval), and blind expert human evaluations by three ML PhDs that statistically corroborate system gains [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0048, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0065, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0066].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline recovery and quality improvements are directly verified by objective execution measurement (11/12 vs 5/12 metrics-bearing runs) and blind expert human evaluations showing statistically significant advantages (p = 0.031) [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0048, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0066].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are established via execution success (generating task-relevant metrics), artifact scores from external blind LLM judges (Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Sonnet 4.6), and blind human ratings by three ML PhD reviewers [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0043, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0048, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0060, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0066].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: During the experimental recovery loop, trajectory summary statistics (decay and slope) alongside an independent LLM critic provide severity scores that feed a deterministic routing rule to drive code and protocol repair [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0028, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0029, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0030].

primary.limitations: The authors transparently discuss the small benchmark sample size (12 topics), practical API budget limits forcing maximum pivot bounds, lack of external literature retrieval during causal generation, and lack of human evaluation beyond the ML domain [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0131, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0136, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0137, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0138].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is explicitly detailed, formalizing trajectory features (decay, slope), divergent causal attribution with independent critic ranking, deterministic routing rules with a data-sufficiency clamp, and post-draft numeric sanitization against measured artifact logs [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0028, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0029, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0030, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0031, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0036]. Ablation studies and sensitivity analyses show that multi-hypothesis generation and independent critic audits are critical to performance [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0070, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0121].
primary.quality_rationale: The work presents an exceptionally honest, well-controlled, and methodical study of failure recovery in autonomous research agents. The empirical findings are backed by objective execution statistics, multi-judge automated reviews, and human expert validation, with candid treatment of unresolved flaws.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces SAGE, an autonomous research framework featuring Multi-Hypothesis Failure Attribution (MHFA) and grounded reporting, which replaces monolithic verbal reflection with structured causal diagnosis, deterministic routing across abstraction levels, and numeric table verification against empirical run registries [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0002, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0008, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0034].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The work presents an exceptionally honest, well-controlled, and methodical study of failure recovery in autonomous research agents. The empirical findings are backed by objective execution statistics, multi-judge automated reviews, and human expert validation, with candid treatment of unresolved flaws.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors transparently discuss the small benchmark sample size (12 topics), practical API budget limits forcing maximum pivot bounds, lack of external literature retrieval during causal generation, and lack of human evaluation beyond the ML domain [E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0131, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0136, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0137, E37215fcd0e80c2fb-B0138].
